_doc: Creative direction that supersedes the frozen source package.
_precedence: v1.0.6 wins on SOURCE TRUTH - claims, locators, evidence, attribution, rights, gates, and the sourced-versus-artistic classification. The directing packs win on CREATIVE DIRECTION - performance, framing intent, sound, rhythm. An override may never change what is true, only how it is shown. Anything here that would alter a claim, a locator, an attribution or a gate is a defect in this file.
_why_this_file_exists: The package is frozen and must never be edited. Where a pack corrects a stale creative note in it, the correction lives here and is applied at prompt-assembly time, so the package stays byte-identical and the correction is still impossible to forget.
